picks.what: General view from the south with the Alexander Nevsky Cathedral, postcard
picks.why: general view over the rooftops of Yekaterinodar to its five-domed cathedral (demolished in the 1930s); caption in the sky trimmed

gaps: P0–P3: nothing; P5: nothing (the 1944 hits are Armavir; the 1917 Kuban riverbank postcard is only dated ‘before 1917’)
notes: Kept the 2020 P6 skyline; the 2010/2015 hits are a village and mountains elsewhere in the region. The colored Kuban riverbank postcard with Holy Trinity Church (#8) is a genuine Yekaterinodar view, probably 1900s–1910s, but too vaguely dated and small.
